tasks.title: check-sources: a row where every cell is a link passes
tasks.body: The docs checker scripts/check-sources.mjs accepts a table row where every cell is a link. Make the checker reject such a row, with a test.

tasks.title: repo-id edges: double slash and bracketed IPv6
tasks.body: Repo ids from remotes are wrong at two edges: `https://github.com//org//repo` keeps the double slash, and `git@[::1]:org/repo` is mangled. Make repoIdFrom return one clean id for each, with tests.

tasks.title: a garbage hq.db prints a raw stack
tasks.body: A garbage hq.db makes HQ print a raw stack and exit 1 instead of raising StoreCorruptError and exiting 3. Make opening a file that is not a database a StoreCorruptError, with a test.

tasks.title: GitHub contents API returns empty content for files over 1 MB
tasks.body: The GitHub contents API returns empty content for files over 1 MB, so the reviewer sees an empty file instead of a 'not shown' marker. Make files() report such a file as not shown, with a test on the fake host.

tasks.title: entity-encoded mentions pass the body guard
tasks.body: Entity-encoded mentions (`@x`, `@x`) pass the body guard in server/githost/sanitize.ts while `@x` is refused. Refuse or neutralise them the same way, with a test.

tasks.title: suspect scan misses published global symbols
tasks.body: The suspect scan in bench/testside.ts misses `(globalThis as any)[Symbol.for("expect-global")]?.extend({...})` and `chai.use(...)` through an existing vitest import. Add `Symbol.for(`, `expect-global`, `$$jest-matchers-object`, `__vitest_worker__`, `overwriteMethod` and `addMethod` to SUSPECT, with a test for each.

tasks.title: canonical() refuses Linux-legal names that look like drive paths
tasks.body: canonical() in bench/protected.ts refuses Linux-legal names such as `a:b.md` and `c:notes.md` and fails the whole PR. Refuse real drive paths (`C:/x`, `C:\\x`) and accept these names, with tests.

tasks.title: a git typechange grades fail
tasks.body: A git typechange (a file becomes a directory or the reverse) grades fail with a note because grading writes before it deletes. Apply deletes first so a typechange grades like any other change, with a test.

tasks.title: ScratchTarget does not pin the owner
tasks.body: ScratchTarget accepts `someoneelse/agent-works-scratch` and `FiatFour/-scratch`. Pin the owner to FiatFour and require a real repo name, with tests.

tasks.title: scratch ref patterns stop at run 999
tasks.body: `--runs` accepts up to 1000 but the scratch ref patterns BASE_REF and WORK_REF stop at r999, so run 1000 is refused as a ref the bench may not write. Make the patterns and the cap agree, with a test.
